stem.x: Which of the following is refactoring in software development activities?

b.x: In order to improve the maintainability of a program, its internal structure is modified without any change to the external specifications.
In order to improve the quality of a program, two programmers cooperate to perform the coding of a single program.
In order to obtain feedback from users, the prototype of a program to be provided is created at an early stage.
In order to promptly develop a program to be operated, test cases are set in advance, and the program is then coded.
